prompt: A company produces custom circuit boards. For every 100 boards initially produced, 15% are found to be defective during the first inspection. Of these defective boards, 80% can be repaired. However, after repair, when these boards are re-inspected, 10% of *those repaired boards* are found to be defective again and are discarded. The company needs to deliver exactly 1764 perfectly functional boards. How many boards must be initially produced to meet this delivery requirement?
